long_biography.plain_text:
Raised on a farm near Adelong, New South Wales, Barry-Cotter discovered sailing after his family moved to Sydney. He began a boatbuilding apprenticeship at 16, built his own boat by 19 and became an early Australian adopter of fibreglass production. He later established Riviera on the Gold Coast, growing it from five employees into a major exporter.

Offshore powerboat racing became a parallel engineering laboratory. Barry-Cotter competed at the sport’s highest level, while lessons from hull design, propulsion and testing fed back into production. He went on to create Maritimo and remained closely involved in product development as management passed to the next generation. Appointed a Member of the Order of Australia for service to maritime construction, powerboat racing and charitable organisations, he has created three internationally recognised boat brands.
